sections.title: Describing style
sections.content:
Vocabulary for discussing how people look and dress:
• elegant — gracefully stylish. She always looks elegant even in simple clothes.
• scruffy — untidy and dirty. He turned up looking rather scruffy in torn jeans.
• flamboyant — attracting attention with bold style. He's known for his flamboyant outfits.
• understated — subtly stylish without being showy. Her understated jewellery was perfect for the occasion.
• vintage — clothing from a previous era. She loves shopping for vintage dresses from the 1960s.

sections.title: Materials and fashion terms
sections.content:
More specific fashion vocabulary:
• haute couture — high-end custom-made fashion. Haute couture dresses can cost tens of thousands.
• wardrobe — a person's entire collection of clothes. She completely updated her wardrobe for the new job.
• tailored — made to fit a specific person. A tailored suit always looks more professional.
• accessorise — add extras like jewellery or bags. A simple dress can be transformed by how you accessorise.
• trendsetter — someone who starts new fashions. Fashion bloggers are the new trendsetters.

exercises.question: Clothing that is gracefully stylish and refined is:
Someone who looks untidy and dishevelled is:
exercises.explanation: Scruffy means shabby and untidy in appearance.

exercises.question: Style that is subtle and not showy is:
exercises.explanation: Understated means presented or expressed in a subtle way.

exercises.question: A person who introduces new fashion trends is a:
exercises.explanation: A trendsetter is a person who leads the way in fashion or ideas.

exercises.question: Clothing custom-made to fit one person is:
exercises.explanation: Tailored means made or adapted for a particular purpose or person.

exercises.question: Exclusive, custom-made high fashion is:
exercises.explanation: Haute couture is the designing and making of high-quality, custom-fitted clothing.

exercises.question: Clothes from a previous era that are still fashionable are:
exercises.explanation: Vintage describes clothing or items from an earlier period that are valued for quality.

exercises.question: To add jewellery, bags, or scarves to an outfit is to:
exercises.explanation: To accessorise means to add accessories to complement an outfit.
